## 主张 Claim

给定有限类型项语言、代入与前后赋值，全部消费者在代入前后求值相同，当且仅当每个替换项给出其原位置的根据。构造的代入在嵌套假设下保留位置；单假设接入与先后代入满足相应语义等式。 / For the supplied finite typed-term language, substitution and context assignments, every consumer evaluates equally before and after replacement iff each replacement term supplies the ground at its original position. Constructed substitution retains positions under nested binders; single insertion and successive substitution satisfy the corresponding semantic equations.

Canonical source: [InferentialSubstitution.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/InferentialSubstitution.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 使用既有 InferentialGrounds 的有限项、类型及求值；同一原子载体族与稳定的绑定位置给定。无可变状态、非终止或物理成本。 / Uses existing InferentialGrounds finite terms, types and evaluation, with the same atomic carrier family and stable binding positions; no mutable state, divergence or physical cost.
- 全部消费者的范围包括每个位置的直接使用。判断保持另须假设保证及实际生产根据满足输入要求；这两个前提不被代入定理证明。 / The all-consumer scope includes direct use of every position. Assessment preservation additionally requires a hypothetical guarantee and an actual producer satisfying its input criterion; substitution does not prove either premise.
